# Digital Fuel

> Digital Fuel is a digital content and performance marketing agency based in Marlborough, Massachusetts. It plans, builds and runs online advertising for companies across the United States, with its deepest experience in home renovation and construction. The team works in English and Portuguese.

## Key facts

- Type: Digital content and performance marketing agency
- Based in: Marlborough, Massachusetts, USA
- Serves: Companies across the United States
- Industries: Home renovation, construction, home services, retail, local services
- Services: Websites, SEO, Google Ads, Meta ads, content and video, email and SMS, CRM and automation
- Experience: Over 10 years
- Languages: English and Portuguese
- Address: 2 Mt Royal Ave, Suite 210, Marlborough, MA 01752, USA
- Phone: +1 (351) 210-2512
- Email: contact@digitalfuelagency.com
- Certifications shown on the site: Meta Business Partner, Google Partner, Google Analytics Certified Professional, BBB Accredited Business (A+)

## Services

- Website design: Custom websites built to bring in qualified leads. Hosting and ongoing support included.
- Content and social media: Posts, photos and video for the platforms your customers use every day.
- Photo and video production: Commercial photo and video shoots, with editing for ads and social.
- Branding and design: Visual identity and design that make a small company look established.
- SEO and local SEO: Built to put your business on page one of Google in your local market, for the searches your customers type.
- Google Search Ads: Campaigns aimed at people searching for your service right now, so the phone rings.
- Google Local Services Ads: Appear at the very top of Google for local searches and get calls from customers ready to hire.
- Meta ads: Facebook and Instagram: Targeted ads on the platforms your customers scroll every day, built to generate leads.
- Online reviews and Google Business Profile: A steady flow of new reviews and a tuned Google Business Profile, so your reputation sells for you.
- CRM and automation (FuelStation): FuelStation, our CRM and automation platform, keeps every lead in one place and follows up for you by text and email.
- AI agent: voice and text: An AI agent that answers calls and messages around the clock, so no lead goes cold.
- Email and SMS marketing: Campaigns that bring past customers back and keep new leads warm.
- Call and form tracking: See which ad, keyword or page produced each call and each form.

## Programs

- GROW (Scale organically): Marketing strategy; Custom website; Search engine optimization; Google Local Services Ads; Meta ads: Facebook and Instagram leads; Video editing; Support and reports.
- SCALE (Results guaranteed): Everything in Grow, plus: Local SEO and reviews boost; Google Search Ads; Custom landing pages; Call and form tracking; CRM setup and management; 8 social media posts.
- ACCELERATE (Local domination): Everything in Scale, plus: Personalized CRM automations; AI agent: voice and text; Advanced SEO: blog, listings, links; Email marketing campaigns; SMS marketing campaigns; CRM sales training; Market exclusivity; Commercial photo and video production.

Pricing is not published. It depends on the program and the market, and is given in a free strategy session.

## Who it is for

- Home renovation and construction: Our deepest experience. General contractors, painters, electricians, stone fabricators, coating and equipment companies already run on Digital Fuel.
- Home services: For the trades that live on local calls: cleaning, landscaping, roofing, HVAC.
- Retail: Stores and product brands that need foot traffic and online sales.
- Local and professional services: Any business that sells a service and needs a steady flow of qualified leads.
- Brazilian-owned businesses in the United States: campaigns run in English for American customers, with account contact in Portuguese.

## Frequently asked questions

### What does Digital Fuel do?

Digital Fuel is a digital content and performance marketing agency based in Marlborough, Massachusetts. We plan, build and run online advertising for companies across the United States: websites, SEO, Google Ads, Meta ads, content, email and automation.

### Which industries does Digital Fuel work with?

We work with companies that sell products and services, and our deepest experience is in home renovation and construction. Our clients include general contractors, painters, electricians, stone fabricators and retailers.

### Where is Digital Fuel located, and do you work outside Massachusetts?

Our office is at 2 Mt Royal Ave, Suite 210, Marlborough, MA 01752. We work with clients in every part of the United States.

### How do you measure results?

We measure results in leads, calls and sales. Every program includes support and reports, and the Scale and Accelerate programs add call and form tracking with a CRM, so you can see where each lead came from.

### How much does it cost to work with Digital Fuel?

The price depends on the program you choose (Grow, Scale or Accelerate) and on your market. You get the exact number in your free strategy session, before you commit to anything.

### How long does it take to see results?

Google Ads and Local Services Ads can start bringing calls within days of launch. SEO takes longer, usually a few months, and keeps working after that.

### Do you work in Portuguese?

Yes. Our team works in English and Portuguese, and this site is available in both languages.

### What happens in the free strategy session?

We learn about your business, your market and your goals, then show you a plan built for your company. The session is free and you decide what happens next.

### Do I need a new website to start?

Every program includes a custom website built to generate leads, with hosting and ongoing support.
